newsitem.title: HUNGARY: DENG MOST INFLUENTIAL MAN IN MODERN CHINA - HUNGARY.
newsitem.headline: DENG MOST INFLUENTIAL MAN IN MODERN CHINA - HUNGARY.

text.p: Hungary described Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, who died on Wednesday, as the most influential figure in China's modern history.

"Deng was perhaps the most influential personality of modern Chinese history, whose openness to reform was of epoch-making importance in his country"s modernisation," Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs told Hungarian news agency MTI.
Kovacs said Deng had played an extremely important role in eliminating the political and economic chaos the Cultural Revolution had caused and then in launching economic reforms.
He said that under Deng"s leadership, rebuilding of relations between the international community and previously-isolated China began.

"When I visited China last December, I personally experienced the imposing economic development that is the result of the reforms he launched and which are the most important conditions for the development and transformation of Chinese society," Kovacs said.

Kovacs said he did not expect any essential changes in either Chinese foreign or internal policy, as Deng had long since held no official functions and his direct influence over China"s direction had gradually declined.
"The reformist technocrat leaders who, for the most part, were promoted to senior posts today have determining positions in Chinese leadership," he added.
